objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-password-policy-discovery-with-net
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the execution of `net.exe` with command line arguments aimed at obtaining the computer or domain password policy. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names and command-line executions.
